tutorial.title: Touch Events
tutorial.descriptionContent: Learn how to use touch events on your websites.

lessons.title: Lesson #1
lessons.interactiveContent:
Let's learn to apply touch events to a mini game so players can trigger an action. Press and hold the hero sprite and see what happens.

Note: the following lessons will only be interactive on touch displays.

lessons.title: Lesson #2
lessons.interactiveContent:
We use touch events to determine whether a player has interacted with a game element and then use a function to perform a specific action.

Let's create a function that adds the text "Power up!" to an element once a touch event happens.

Make sure to pick function followed by displayPowerUp and then touchstart, displayPowerUp.

lessons.title: Lesson #3
lessons.interactiveContent:
When we want to check whether players have begun to interact with an element, we use the touchstart event.

Let's set the code to run the function immediately when a player touches the sprite.

Make sure to pick touchstart.

lessons.title: Lesson #4
lessons.interactiveContent:
When we want to determine whether a player has interacted with an element for a prolonged time, we use the touchmove event.

Code touchmove to run the function when a player moves their finger across the hero sprite.

Make sure to type touchmove.

lessons.title: Lesson #5
lessons.interactiveContent:
To check whether a player has stopped interacting with an element, we use the touchend event.

Let's make the text disappear when a player removes their finger from the sprite.

Make sure to pick touchend.

lessons.title: Lesson #6
lessons.interactiveContent:
Finally, it's good coding practice to check if a touch event gets interrupted using the touchcancel event.

Code touchcancel, and then while touching the sprite, swipe your finger off the screen to interrupt the touch event.

Make sure to type touchcancel.

lessons.title: Lesson #7
lessons.interactiveContent:
What happens when a player touches the element of ID potion?

The text Health +30 is added to the hud elementThe text Gold +10 is added to the hud element

The text Health +30 is added to the hud element.

lessons.title: Lesson #8
lessons.interactiveContent:
What touch event is triggered when a player begins to interact with an element?

The touchstart eventThe touchmove event

The touchstart event.

lessons.title: Lesson #9
lessons.interactiveContent:
When is the touchmove touch event triggered?

When a player interacts with an element for a prolonged timeWhen a player starts to interact with an element

When a player interacts with an element for a prolonged time.

lessons.title: Lesson #10
lessons.interactiveContent:
When is the touchend touch event triggered?

When a player stops interacting with an elementWhen the player double touches the element

When a player stops interacting with an element.

lessons.title: Lesson #11
lessons.interactiveContent:
What event do we use to check whether a touch event has been interrupted?

We use the touchcancel eventWe use the touchend event

We use the touchcancel event.

lessons.title: Lesson #12
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the value that makes the code display "Sword Equipped" after a player touches the item sprite.

Make sure to type displayName.

lessons.title: Lesson #13
lessons.interactiveContent:
Next, code the touch event value to check whether a player has begun interacting with the item sprite.

Make sure to type touchstart.

lessons.title: Lesson #14
lessons.interactiveContent:
Check whether a player has moved their finger across the item sprite by coding the correct touch event value.

Make sure to type touchmove.

lessons.title: Lesson #15
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the touch event to check whether a player has stopped interacting with the item sprite.

Run the code and press on the sprite for a long time and then release to call the function displayName.

Make sure to type touchend.

lessons.title: Lesson #16
lessons.interactiveContent:
Lastly, to adhere to best coding practices, code the touch event to check whether a touch event has been interrupted.

Then try touching the sprite to see when the event takes place.

Make sure to type touchcancel.
